terms.name: 3-Year CPF-OA HDB Loan
terms.terms: CPF-OA-linked variable rate, not a fixed rate. 75% LTV: 25 years max loan tenor (provided borrower age + tenure ≤ 65 years old) 55% LTV: 30 years max loan tenor (provided borrower age + tenure > 65 years old). Confirm eligibility, fees and available package with DBS.
